environment.description: AWS Lambda function invoked as a task within a Step Functions workflow. The Lambda is fronted by API Gateway (HTTP API) with no WAF attached. The API Gateway endpoint is publicly accessible at https://abc123.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/prod/status. The Lambda runs in the 'workflow-tasks' namespace of an EKS cluster with Istio sidecar injection enabled, but the Istio AuthorizationPolicy only applies to east-west (pod-to-pod) traffic. The API Gateway ingress bypasses the mesh entirely since it routes directly to the Lambda ARN via AWS service integration, not through the Istio ingress gateway.

config.api_gateway: HTTP API, no WAF, public endpoint
config.istio_sidecar: enabled but Lambda invocation is via AWS SDK not mesh
config.network: Lambda in VPC but API GW integration is AWS_PROXY direct
